purpose: Athena's adopter-local V26-1467 M1 comparison authority: one entry per binding-admitted Athena shadow delivery, carrying the binding-sourced projection-consumption record alongside the intervention and blocked-share measurements compared against the frozen manual-choreography baseline. The harness repository's separate record is product self-dogfood evidence; it neither fills nor duplicates this record's three delivery slots. A measurement artifact, not a journal. Entries are written by the product's binding, which ships at the product's pinned commit; this list is empty because no binding-admitted Athena shadow delivery is recorded, not because no producer exists. Current path-name observation is diagnostic only and cannot fill a slot; trustworthy exact-projection read evidence, repository-bound target validation, and a like-for-like merge-ready-report measurement endpoint remain explicit pre-M1 implementation gaps. Its location is already outside every execution grant's writable paths: `.agents` is an additionally protected path in all three checkpoint grants of .agents/policy/repository-policy.json, so no session may author an entry. Nothing in this record claims runtime enforcement, M1 success, or cutover readiness.

comparisonSetRequirement.note: the counted set must match the baseline's mix and count; a delivery never counts without an affirmative binding-sourced record backed by a model-external exact-path workflow-source read event and written only after the target repository identity is derived and matched, whatever its measurements say

gateMetrics.medianOperatorInterventionsAfterAcceptan: reported in full and gates nothing. The baseline's own intervention counts are [2, 0, 0] — a median of 0, which is the floor of the metric. No non-negative count can be strictly lower, so a baseline sitting at the floor cannot demonstrate improvement in either direction. The baseline's limitations block concedes the counts are lower bounds: transcripts do not record silently granted host permission prompts, so the figure it reports is admittedly incomplete. Ceasing to gate on the figure is not licence to stop measuring it; it becomes gating again only once the baseline is re-recorded under a rubric wide enough to have headroom.
gateMetrics.blockedVersusProgressingShare: must not regress against the baseline's over the same acceptance-through-first-merge-ready-report endpoint; eventual merge and post-report wait are excluded, and the baseline must be re-recorded if its transcripts cannot derive that endpoint; the sole gating criterion
gateMetrics.policyRequiredInterruptions: recorded and reported alongside interventions, never counted as interventions

consumptionRecordContract.requiredSource: binding, admitted only from its existing model-external observation boundary's trustworthy exact-path workflow-source read event

shape.projectionDigest: the digest the binding receipted at materialization

marker.deliveryId: the delivery the projection was materialized for
marker.fence: the invocation fence the marker binds
marker.consumed: the pinned generation archive proved loaded or read as the run's workflow source by the model-external event; a path name or echoed marker alone cannot satisfy this field

consumptionRecordContract.rejected: any record whose source is not the binding, whose only evidence is a path name or echoed marker, or whose writer has not derived and matched the target repository identity — a session-authored, otherwise agent-supplied, non-consuming, unsupported-host, or cross-repository claim is excluded and must leave the record unchanged
